leadText: Yūji Ueda (Japanese: うえだゆうじ Ueda Yūji) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Yūji Ueda (Japanese: うえだゆうじ Ueda Yūji) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Ueda was born on June 15, 1967, in , , and he became a voice actor as an adult. He previously used the kanji form of his name as his stage name, 上田祐司. He joined at the beginning, and he is best known as the voices of and Jessie's Wobbuffet. He has also provided several voices for minor characters, as well as the voices of many Pokémon. Ueda is married to fellow voice actor . He was initially affiliated with , but he left on July 1, 2004, and then joined Office Osawa on April 1, 2005.
